parts:
A year ago, I wasn't myself.

I was surviving. Carrying the weight of things that were never mine to carry. Walking on eggshells. Shrinking. Explaining. Apologizing. Giving pieces of myself away to people who were more than willing to take them.

The last seven years tested me in ways I never thought possible. Narcissism. Manipulation. Repression. Constantly feeling like someone was sucking the life right out of me while I convinced myself I just needed to try harder.

Not anymore.

A year later, I finally feel like myself again.

The real me.

The woman who built businesses from nothing.
The woman who survived things that should have broken her.
The woman who refuses to quit.
The woman who knows exactly what she brings to the table and isn't afraid to sit there alone if she has to.

For the first time in a very long time, I feel normal again.

I wake up excited about my future instead of anxious about surviving my present.

I have a son who makes me proud beyond words. Watching him step into the next chapter of his life has reminded me that all the sacrifices, all the hard days, all the battles were worth it.

I have a man who loves me in a way I never knew existed. Not someone who competes with me, controls me, or diminishes me. A true partner. My best friend. My person.

And I have a business that is on the verge of changing the trajectory of my entire bloodline.

Let that sink in.

Not just my life.

My family's life.

Generations after me.

The little girl who once felt forgotten, overlooked, and not enough could never have imagined this version of her future.

But she kept going anyway.

This isn't a glow-up.

This is a comeback.

A resurrection.

A reminder that sometimes God has to remove everything that is breaking you before He can give you everything that was meant for you.

I don't have it all figured out, but for the first time in years, I know exactly who I am.

And she's a boss-ass woman who's done asking for permission.

The future I've been praying for is finally here.

And we're just getting started. ❤️🔥✨
